title: On GitHub the owner and team I've declared get their role's tools behind the must-ask gate; strangers stay community (IDENTITY-12.a)
description: On GitHub the owner and team I've declared get their role's tools behind the must-ask gate; strangers stay community (IDENTITY-12.a)
acceptance_criteria: IDENTITY-12.a (captured in this change's PR from Leif's 2026-09-28 interview, round 16): 'On GitHub, the owner and team members I've declared get their role's tools too, behind the same must-ask gate; anyone else stays community.' The WATCH poller resolves the person who triggered a run - the comment or issue-body author that @mentioned the watch user, by the GitHub numeric user id the API reported, in the owner's people list (watchTriggerRole) - to owner, team or community; an assignment or review request (triggered by someone else on the thread, known by login only) is community, never the thread author's role. The WATCH spawn stamps that role like a Discord run (owner: CORVIDINHO_ACTING_IS_ADMIN=1 and CORVIDINHO_ACTING_ROLE=owner; team: ROLE=team; else 0/community; CORVIDINHO_ACTING_WORK_TASK=0), always overwritten. The tool layer (resolveActingIsAdmin / resolveActingRole in src/plugins/roles.ts) re-resolves it on a watch-surface run from CORVIDINHO_ACTING_GITHUB_ID only (never a login or a Discord id; a Discord run never uses the GitHub keys) at every call: a role change, a GitHub deny_users login or id, or the person's Discord id muted or deny-listed applies at the next call; the stamp only lowers. An owner WATCH run's must-ask call raises the owner's Approve card (from watch:<session>) and runs only on approval; team and community runs are refused for owner-only tools before any card. WATCH limits stay: no shell, runners, Fledge runs or discovered Fledge plugin commands (SAFE-3.a; REQ-agent-1201), secret-looking paths hidden for every role on GitHub, never a /work task, workers community, thread text fenced. tests/watch.github-roles.test.ts fails on the base sources and passes on the branch.
